description.value: The North Vancouver Tennis Centre is a public indoor tennis facility operated by the North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission (NVRC). It sits within the NVRC network of community recreation centres serving the District of North Vancouver. Touring cyclists in the area may find it a useful stop given its recreation-centre context, which often includes complementary amenities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific tennis centre page (https://www.nvrc.ca/parks-recreation/find-facility/north-vancouver-tennis-centre) returned a 404 Page Not Found after NVRC relaunched their website, so no facility-specific amenity detail is available from the website. However, the Tennis Centre is listed by name in the NVRC site navigation under Facilities & Fields > Locations & Hours, confirming it is a real, active NVRC-operated facility. No amenity details can be confirmed for any required or optional criteria; all are set to null per the rules.
concerns: The specific facility URL returns a 404 Page Not Found following NVRC's website redesign; amenity details are unverifiable until the page is updated or a new URL is found.
No phone number present in OSM tags; NVRC general customer service line is 604-987-7529 (from contact page) but this is not specific to the Tennis Centre.
OSM tags do not include postal code; address cannot be fully confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible NVRC-operated tennis facility confirmed active via site navigation; 404 on specific page is a website migration issue, not a closure indicator.
enrichment_extras.notes: NVRC general customer service: 604-987-7529 / CustomerService@nvrc.ca. Mailing address for NVRC admin: 851 West Queens Road, North Vancouver, BC V7N 4E3 (not the Tennis Centre address).

wow_evidence: NVRC-run public indoor tennis — public facility (unlike the commercial Tennis Centre chain).
blurb: Public indoor tennis centre run by NVRC.
